title: Repair Service Terms of the Northloop Protect Plans: In-Home Service, Shipping for Repair and Food Loss
content:
Under the Northloop Protect Plans, items of the in-home service categories are repaired in the home; on every plan, shipping to and from repair is paid by the plan; and food spoilage after a covered refrigerator failure is reimbursed up to 250.00 USD.

## Service terms by plan

| Plan | Item categories repaired in the home | Shipping to and from repair paid by the plan | Most reimbursed for food spoilage after a covered refrigerator failure (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | Large appliances, furniture | Yes | 250.00 |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | Large appliances, furniture | Yes | 250.00 |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | Large appliances, furniture | Yes | 250.00 |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | None | Yes | 250.00 |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | None | Yes | 250.00 |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | None | Yes | 250.00 |

## Notes to the terms

- **In-home repair.** Only the three Extended Warranty plans list in-home service categories, and those categories are large appliances and furniture. The Accident Protection plans list none.
- **Shipping for repair.** On all six plans the plan, not the buyer, pays shipping to and from repair.
- **Food loss.** The food loss amount is a ceiling: 250.00 USD is the most reimbursed for food spoilage after a covered refrigerator failure.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A covered refrigerator suffers a covered failure and the spoiled food is valued at 310.00 USD: the most reimbursed for the spoilage is 250.00 USD.
- The same failure with spoiled food valued at 180.00 USD is below the 250.00 USD ceiling, so the ceiling does not limit it.
